intervals.label: hosting the Bugey reactor-antineutrino experiments
intervals.locator: Studies of Neutrino Oscillations at Reactors (arXiv:nucl-ex/0005002), introduction
intervals.note: Year of the Bugey oscillation results, used as a lower bound for the experimental use of the site; the plant itself is older and its commissioning dates were not sourced. The interval is open because no source consulted says the plant has stopped; the Bugey experiments continued into later neutrino work (e.g. MUNU) not recorded here.
intervals.quote: results from the reactors at ILL ... in 1981, at Goesgen ... in 1986, and at Bugey ... in 1995 have found no evidence for neutrino oscillations

summary.plain: A French nuclear power station on the Rhone near Lyon whose reactors served as the antineutrino source for the Bugey experiments of the 1990s, which measured the antineutrino rate and spectrum 15 to 95 metres from a reactor core.
summary.technical: Bugey nuclear power plant (CNPE du Bugey), Saint-Vulbas, Ain, France: 2,800 MW_th reactors; site of the Bugey-3 (15, 40, 95 m) and Bugey-4 (15 m integral) short-baseline reactor antineutrino experiments.
